notes: ScubaGear 2.0 support for the Microsoft 365 connector (Security Suite, manual and incorrect-result handling, tenant domain). MSP contracts gain payment-protection clauses (suspension, late charges, invoice disputes, collection costs, early termination, ownership until paid, billable offboarding, price changes, assignment, incorporation), annual prepaid pricing, and overdue notices for day 1, 15, 30 and 60.
